channel.title: Ben Chaplin
channel.description: Writing about problems in tech and math.

item.title: How Elasticsearch's batched query phase improves search performance at scale (outside link)
item.description: Bettering Elasticsearch query time and resource utilization by batching shard queries.

item.title: Elasticsearch Replica Management in Serverless (outside link)
item.description: How Elasticsearch Serverless combines two automated systems: one for failover resilience, one for search load balancing.

item.title: Search for Lost Hands
item.description: Building a fun little Lucene search that works when your fingers drift on the keyboard.

item.title: Correlation is Hard
item.description: Generating a filter that hits a target selectivity and correlation turns out to be trickier than it sounds, so I work through a numeric approach to get there.

item.title: Building a Bigger HNSW Graph
item.description: A follow-up that scales the HNSW example up and ties off the loose ends: how candidate lists are built and what the efConst (beamWidth) parameter actually does.

item.title: Building an HNSW Graph
item.description: A hands-on walkthrough of building a Hierarchical Navigable Small World graph from scratch, inserting vectors one by one.

item.title: Just-in-time Loop Unrolling
item.description: Unpacking why Lucene's dot-product code accumulates in chunks of four, and how loop unrolling and the JIT combine to make it faster.

item.title: Lightweight Search in the Browser with Lunr
item.description: Adding a real search bar to a static, backend-less site by scraping your own pages at build time and indexing them client-side with Lunr.

item.title: JavaCC and LL(1) Parsers
item.description: Chasing down a backslash-escaping bug in an Apache Lucene grammar, and what JavaCC's LL(1) token matching taught me about why it happened.
